name: travel-photo-abstraction
title_zh: 把旅行照片拆成抽象下栏构图的艺术排版器
tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，它拆解视觉证据、提炼关系，重组成带编号日期的下栏抽象构图。19 张参考图兜底，专治只会套滤镜不会重构。
tagline_en: Upload a photo; it deconstructs visual evidence, distills relationships, and rebuilds a numbered, dated abstract.
desc_en: Analyze the photograph uploaded by the user, deconstruct its visual evidence, abstract and distill the essential relationships, then reconstruct them as a new nonliteral lower-panel composition guided by 19 bundled references. Use for CLEAN upper-photo/lower-abstraction editorial artworks with a number, date, and short phrase in the lower panel. This is abstraction and reconstruction, never style
why_zh: 不是风格迁移，是真正的抽象与重构：它先拆解再重组，让下栏构图与上栏照片形成编辑级对位，而非简单叠加。
why_en: Not style transfer—true abstraction and reconstruction. It deconstructs then rebuilds, creating editorial counterpoint between.
limit_zh: 只认干净的上图/下栏版式；照片必须清晰可辨，否则抽象会失真。产物止于构图建议与排版参考，不输出可印刷文件。
limit_en: Only clean upper-photo/lower-panel layouts; photo must be legible or abstraction distorts. Output is composition guidance, not print-ready files.
title_en: Turn travel photos into abstract lower-panel editorial art
